questions.q: Where does almost every Salesforce admin task begin?
options: Setup, reached from the gear icon
questions.explain: Setup, opened from the gear icon in the top right of any org, is where configuration work happens.

questions.q: In Setup's Administration section, which group of tools does this chapter's content live under?
questions.explain: Users, Profiles, Permission Sets, Permission Set Groups, and Roles are grouped under Administration > Users.

questions.q: What does Salesforce Classic's "Administer > Manage Users" menu correspond to in Lightning Experience?
options: A completely different, unrelated feature set
The same Users/Profiles/Permission Sets toolkit under Administration
A deprecated feature with no Lightning equivalent
questions.explain: Classic and Lightning expose the same underlying admin tools; only the menu styling differs.

questions.q: Which of the four areas an admin controls does Chapter 1 focus on?
questions.explain: Chapter 1, Users and Access, is entirely about deciding who gets into the org and what they can do.

questions.q: What is the Quick Find box used for in Setup?
options: Jumping directly to any configuration setting by name
questions.explain: Quick Find is a search box at the top of Setup that filters the configuration tree to matching settings.
